en.bdb: Indenticalness of the Sikh with the Guru
The greatness of the gurmukh is that he being the philosopher’s stone makes every one a philosopher’s stone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: heerai heeraa bedhiaa jotee jot milaiee|

en.bdb: As the diamond is cut by the diamond, the light of the gurmukh merges in Supreme Light.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ੍ਰੀ ਵਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv leen hoi ja(n)tr ja(n)trree vaiee|

en.bdb: His consciousness is attuned to the Word as the mind of the player absorbs in the instrument.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਰਚਾ ਪਰਚਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: gur chelaa chelaa guroo parachaa parachaiee|

en.bdb: Now the disciple and the Guru become identical.  They become one and merge in one another.
From man was born man (from Guru Nanak to Guru Angad) and he became the superior man.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਕੈ ਹੋਇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit_en: veeh ikeeh ula(n)gh kai hoi sahaj samaiee ||8||

en.bdb: Crossing the world with one jump he merged in the innate knowledge.
